jobs.title: Survey Field Technician
jobs.description:
Founded in 1964, TTL is an engineering design firm focused on delivering integrated infrastructure solutions for public and private clients. From site and corridor selection to due diligence, design, and construction services, TTL is your trusted partner providing single-sourced custom solutions for complex infrastructure development. With more than 500 team members across the Southern United States, TTL provides a wide range of services, including civil engineering; transportation design and CEI; geotechnical engineering; environmental consulting; construction materials engineering and testing; and surveying, GIS, and mapping.

At TTL, we are driven to serve our clients, driven to serve our communities, and driven to serve our people. TTL not only provides a great work/life balance, but we provide excellent employee benefits such as a robust health & dental plan, vision, 401(k), flexible spending accounts, and generous paid time off (PTO) accrual.

For more information, please go to www.ttlusa.com.

Survey Field Technician—Tuscaloosa, AL

TTL is hiring a Survey Field Technician to support a variety of civil, industrial, environmental and transportation-based projects throughout Alabama. We are seeking someone highly motivated, organized, creative, and responsible who thrives best when working as part of a team. This role is responsible for working all aspects of a survey crew under the direction of the Survey Crew Chief. No experience is required and TTL is willing to train qualified individuals.

Build your Foundation. Build your Future. Build your Legacy.

Come to TTL.

What You’ll Do

Completes field assignments accurately while following the TTL safety protocol for personnel and equipment.
Performs field survey operations on the following surveys: boundary, control, topographic, construction layout and staking, environmental mapping, GPS/GIS surveys, and land surveying.
Works alongside the Crew Chief for completion of field work by performing the administrative functions to include all computations, reduction of field notes, maintaining records, etc.

Requirements

Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent
Ability to communicate professionally orally and in writing
Must possess a valid driver’s license and have a clean driving record
Perform heavy lifting up to 50+ lbs
Must be able to work in outdoor environments in varying weather conditions, including heat and cold
Must be able to work outside typical daily 8 am to 5 pm hours
Must be able to travel with occasional overnight stays

Job Type: Full-time

This position is subject to a pre-employment drug and motor vehicle record check.

TTL is an EEO/AAP employer.

jobs.title: Environmental Project Scientist
jobs.description:
Position:
Environmental Project Scientist, Honolulu, Hawaii Posted:
06/19/2026

We are seeking a motivated Project Geologist, Project Scientist, or Project Engineer with a strong background in environmental remediation to join our Technical Services Organization. This mid-career role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-profile projects, develop technical leadership skills, and grow into a Technical Lead role on small to moderately complex assignments. This position must report to the CAPE office in Honolulu, Hawaii.

Responsibilities

Provide support for project planning, field sampling, quality control oversight, design evaluations, data analysis, and reporting.
Develop technical plans and reports including sampling and analysis plans, quality control plans, and construction completion reports.
Schedule and oversee field activities such as soil, surface water, and groundwater sampling, drilling, subcontractor management, and remediation system operation.
Support proposal development, cost estimating, and preparation of regulatory submittals.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to CAPE’s technical quality standards and procedures.
Collaborate with project and senior management to deliver high-quality results that meet budget, schedule, and client expectations.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, geology, or environmental science; advanced degree preferred.
Experience: Minimum 3 years in environmental remediation. Experience working in Hawaii/Tropical Pacific preferred.
Certifications/Training:
Preferred: Licensed Engineer or Geologist in Training (E.I.T. or G.I.T.) or able to obtain Professional Registration within six months of hire
HAZWOPER 40-hour training (and annual refresher).
Adult First Aid/CPR.
Valid U.S. driver’s license with satisfactory record.
U.S. citizenship required (due to federal contracting requirements).

Strong technical writing, analytical, and communication skills.
Familiarity with federal environmental regulatory programs (CERCLA, RCRA).
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and industry-standard tools (CAD, ArcGIS, modeling software).

Work Environment & Travel

Position requires up to 50% travel annually for project support.
Field conditions may involve exposure to varying weather, hazardous materials, and physical demands.

Salary

$80K - $102K commensurate with experience

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals, and employees’

professional goals, and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share, and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, ADP retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home. Straight time overtime may be offered on certain field assignments.

CAPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We invite all qualified applicants to apply to our open positions.

Communication

Any communication regarding this position will come from an email address ending in cape-inc.com. Scammers may try to imitate our HR team. Please use caution when replying to emails that are from other domains. To ensure you are applying for a legitimate job, please only complete a job application that originates from https://www.cape-inc.com/environmental-jobs.

jobs.title: Healthcare Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description
Hidani Tech is a dynamic recruitment and staffing firm dedicated to helping professionals build meaningful, long-term careers. The company connects top talent with employers through efficient, tailored hiring processes across full-time, contract, and freelance opportunities. With strong expertise and an average placement time of 60 days or less, Hidani Tech offers end-to-end support including resume optimization, interview preparation, and career guidance. The firm focuses on understanding individual goals and strengths to align candidates with roles in diverse sectors such as IT, cybersecurity, software engineering, data, AI, machine learning, biotechnology, life sciences, and other technical and non-technical fields. This personalized approach ensures both professionals and employers benefit from high-quality, well-matched placements.
Role Description
The Healthcare Data Analyst is a full-time remote role responsible for collecting, organizing, and analyzing healthcare-related data to support decision-making and improve clinical and operational outcomes. Day-to-day tasks include cleaning and validating datasets, performing statistical and quantitative analyses, and generating reports and dashboards for stakeholders. The analyst will interpret trends, identify patterns in patient care, utilization, and financial data, and provide insights that inform quality improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives. The role also involves collaborating with clinical, operational, and IT teams to define data requirements, ensure data integrity, and document methodologies and findings. The Healthcare Data Analyst will translate complex analytical results into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and experience in Data Analysis to interpret complex healthcare datasets and derive actionable insights.
Candidates should possess solid Data Management skills, including data cleaning, validation, and organization within databases or data warehouses.
Candidates should possess Data Analytics capabilities, including building reports, dashboards, and visualizations using relevant tools.
Candidates should possess applied knowledge of Statistics to perform quantitative analyses, evaluate trends, and support evidence-based recommendations.
Experience working with healthcare or clinical data (e.g., EHR, claims, quality metrics) and understanding of basic healthcare terminology is beneficial.
Proficiency with analytical and visualization tools (such as Excel, SQL, Python/R, or BI platforms like Power BI or Tableau) is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Public Health, Health Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates in the mobile gaming industry, focusing on developing, publishing, and live-operating diverse games that engage millions globally. It addresses the challenge of connecting players through varied interactive experiences across platforms including mobile, web, PC, and console. The program features a portfolio of popular games, including a squad-based hero collector RPG set in the Marvel Universe, and has established a significant presence in the gaming market.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Data Analyst - Marvel Strike Force is responsible for leveraging data to enhance player engagement, retention, monetization, and overall game health. This role involves generating actionable insights that influence decision-making across product, design, marketing, and operations teams. The position is vital for maintaining and improving the performance and player experience of the game through data-driven strategies.

3. Responsibilities:
• Utilize AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytics workflows while ensuring data quality, privacy, and business relevance.
• Collaborate with multiple teams to translate data into clear insights that drive player and business outcomes.
• Manage recurring business-health reporting including key performance indicators, trend analysis, and executive summaries.
• Analyze player behavior to identify risks, opportunities, and friction points within game systems.
• Design and validate analytics tracking for new features and events to ensure accurate performance measurement.

4. Requirements:
• B.Tech/BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Math, Physics, or related quantitative fields.
• Minimum 2 years of experience in data analytics or similar quantitative roles.
• Proficiency in SQL and Python with experience handling complex queries from multiple sources.
• Experience creating reports using Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.
• Interest and judgment in using AI tools to enhance analytics workflows while safeguarding data integrity.
• Knowledge of A/B testing and experimentation, including design, metrics, and interpretation.
• Strong communication skills to convey analysis into actionable recommendations.
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced live-service environment.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, annual salary ranges from $91,300 to $140,000 USD.
• Eligibility for equity, bonuses, and comprehensive benefits including healthcare, retirement plans, pet insurance, paid holidays, and unlimited paid time off.

The organization operates in the behavioral and social science research sector, focusing on addressing urgent challenges in the United States and globally. The Data Analyst II supports healthcare-related projects by managing and analyzing complex healthcare data to produce high-quality, data-driven insights. jobs.description:
hackajob
is collaborating with Moody's Corporation
to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies

10+ years of business analysis, requirements gathering, and stakeholder management experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data product delivery, ideally supporting finance, revenue, lead-to-cash, or enterprise reporting environments

jobs.description:
Project Coordinator | Capital Markets & Business Operations | Remote Independent Contractor

Executive Agility is seeking expressions of interest from an experienced
Project Coordinator
to join our growing team. This remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement, is an execution & project coordination role with administrative, communication & delivery responsibilities across multiple concurrent projects. You can work from anywhere within the United States. We are not accepting applications from overseas candidates.

The role combines project coordination, administration, client service, document control, communications & digital operations. The successful contractor must be highly organized, detail-driven, AI-literate & comfortable working with senior executives, boards, auditors, lawyers, bankers, contractors & clients.

🔷 WHO WE ARE

Executive Agility is the listing readiness quarterback for U.S. & Canadian capital markets. We help companies prepare for & execute domestic IPOs, up-listings, dual listings, cross-border listings, SPACs & de-SPACs.

We solve two problems: execution readiness & execution coordination. We diagnose the gaps, build the roadmap, execute governance, PCAOB audit & disclosure-readiness workstreams, deploy interim or fractional executives, place independent board directors & coordinate the critical path across counsel, auditors, bankers, boards & management.

Our role is to keep every workstream moving concurrently, not sequentially, so companies accelerate schedule, reduce costs & reduce execution risk.

🔷 THE ROLE

The Project Coordinator will:
✔ Manage project schedules, milestones & execution timelines
✔ Build & maintain Gantt charts, scorecards, trackers & KPI templates
✔ Track actions, risks, issues, decisions & deliverables in structured registers
✔ Coordinate information requests across clients, advisors, contractors & stakeholders
✔ Prepare concise status reports to keep leadership & clients informed
✔ Schedule & coordinate meetings, agendas, minutes, decisions & follow-up actions
✔ Maintain document control, version control & structured filing environments
✔ Coordinate Virtual Data Room setup, uploads, permissions & indexing
✔ Monitor designated inboxes, route emails & track client requests
✔ Handle client enquiries, scheduling, correspondence & follow-ups
✔ Coordinate contractor & candidate administration, records, onboarding documentation, agreements, SOWs & digital execution
✔ Maintain CRM, contact, contractor, candidate & project records
✔ Assist with proposals, presentations, reports, templates & routine business correspondence
✔ Coordinate social-media posting, content scheduling, website updates, outreach & email campaigns
✔ Use AI productivity tools to improve research, drafting, reporting, meeting documentation & workflow efficiency
✔ Identify delays, missing information & unresolved actions and escalate them promptly
✔ Ensure follow-through across assigned workstreams with minimal supervision.

🔷 ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

✔ Prior experience in project coordination, PMO support, project management.
✔ Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams & deadlines
✔ Experience maintaining schedules, Gantt charts, trackers, registers & reports
✔ Strong administration capability, including inboxes, scheduling, records, communications & follow-up
✔ Strong written communication, client-service & reporting skills
✔ High discipline in document control, version control & information management
✔ Competence with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint & Excel
✔ Practical AI literacy and experience using generative-AI tools in business workflows
✔ Ability to work remotely, prioritize independently & deliver agreed outcomes
✔ Sound judgement, confidentiality, accuracy & attention to detail.

🔷 HIGH-VALUE EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS

✔ CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Practising Project Practitioner or equivalent qualification
✔ Diploma of Project Management or similar qualification accompanied by practical project-management experience
✔ Capital-markets, IPO, governance, executive-search, legal, audit, finance, consulting or advisory experience
✔ Virtual Data Room or due-diligence coordination experience
✔ Experience supporting senior executives, boards or multi-advisor projects
✔ Experience with CRM, social media, website, email-campaign or contractor-administration workflows.

Practical project-management experience & portfolio evidence will be required.

🔷 YOUR PROFILE

✔ You create structure, visibility & accountability across complex work
✔ You are comfortable combining project coordination with detailed administration & client service
✔ You communicate professionally with executives, clients, advisors & contractors
✔ You can independently manage routine activities while escalating material issues promptly
✔ You can demonstrate schedules, Gantt charts, registers, dashboards, reports or workflows you have created
✔ You are dependable, responsive & able to keep multiple priorities moving without constant supervision.

✔ Remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement
✔ Variable hours based on client & business requirements

Apply via LinkedIn with a current CV. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly by Executive Agility for a confidential conversation.

Approaches from recruitment agencies will not be responded to.

Provide support for project planning, field sampling, quality control oversight, design evaluations, data analysis, and reporting.

Mentor junior staff and contribute to CAPE’s technical quality standards and procedures.
Collaborate with project and senior management to deliver high-quality results that meet budget, schedule, and client expectations.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, geology, or environmental science; advanced degree preferred.
Experience: Minimum 3 years in environmental remediation. Experience working in Hawaii/Tropical Pacific preferred.

Preferred: Licensed Engineer or Geologist in Training (E.I.T. or G.I.T.) or able to obtain Professional Registration within six months of hire
HAZWOPER 40-hour training (and annual refresher).
Adult First Aid/CPR.
Valid U.S. driver’s license with satisfactory record.
U.S. citizenship required (due to federal contracting requirements).

Strong technical writing, analytical, and communication skills.
Familiarity with federal environmental regulatory programs (CERCLA, RCRA).
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and industry-standard tools (CAD, ArcGIS, modeling software).

Position requires up to 50% travel annually for project support.

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. professional goals, and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share, and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, ADP retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home. Straight time overtime may be offered on certain field assignments.

CAPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We invite all qualified applicants to apply to our open positions.

Any communication regarding this position will come from an email address ending in cape-inc.com. Scammers may try to imitate our HR team. Company Description
Hidani Tech is a dynamic recruitment and staffing firm dedicated to helping professionals build meaningful, long-term careers. The company connects top talent with employers through efficient, tailored hiring processes across full-time, contract, and freelance opportunities. With strong expertise and an average placement time of 60 days or less, Hidani Tech offers end-to-end support including resume optimization, interview preparation, and career guidance. The firm focuses on understanding individual goals and strengths to align candidates with roles in diverse sectors such as IT, cybersecurity, software engineering, data, AI, machine learning, biotechnology, life sciences, and other technical and non-technical fields. This personalized approach ensures both professionals and employers benefit from high-quality, well-matched placements.
Role Description
The Healthcare Data Analyst is a full-time remote role responsible for collecting, organizing, and analyzing healthcare-related data to support decision-making and improve clinical and operational outcomes. Day-to-day tasks include cleaning and validating datasets, performing statistical and quantitative analyses, and generating reports and dashboards for stakeholders. The analyst will interpret trends, identify patterns in patient care, utilization, and financial data, and provide insights that inform quality improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives. The role also involves collaborating with clinical, operational, and IT teams to define data requirements, ensure data integrity, and document methodologies and findings. The Healthcare Data Analyst will translate complex analytical results into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and experience in Data Analysis to interpret complex healthcare datasets and derive actionable insights.
Candidates should possess solid Data Management skills, including data cleaning, validation, and organization within databases or data warehouses.
Candidates should possess Data Analytics capabilities, including building reports, dashboards, and visualizations using relevant tools.
Candidates should possess applied knowledge of Statistics to perform quantitative analyses, evaluate trends, and support evidence-based recommendations.
Experience working with healthcare or clinical data (e.g., EHR, claims, quality metrics) and understanding of basic healthcare terminology is beneficial.
Proficiency with analytical and visualization tools (such as Excel, SQL, Python/R, or BI platforms like Power BI or Tableau) is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Public Health, Health Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

new_jobs.title: Associate Director - Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
hackajob
is collaborating with Moody's Corporation
to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies

10+ years of business analysis, requirements gathering, and stakeholder management experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data product delivery, ideally supporting finance, revenue, lead-to-cash, or enterprise reporting environments
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and testable acceptance criteria
Strong partnership skills across business and technology teams with the ability to influence design decisions and recommend practical, business-aligned solutions
Experience designing business-aligned data products, semantic models, reporting frameworks, and reusable analytics solutions in partnership with engineering teams
Knowledge of data modeling, Lakehouse and data warehousing concepts including dimensional modeling, semantic layers, data quality, lineage, and governance
Experience with Databricks, Microsoft Power BI, or comparable analytics platforms; familiarity with CRM and analytical source systems such as Salesforce is preferred
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to validate data, challenge assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy and usability
Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Responsibilities

Partner with business and technology teams to design and deliver trusted analytics, reporting, data products, and AI-enabled solutions.

Partner with Business Intelligence, Financial Planning and Analysis, Sales Planning and Analytics, and other stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and prioritize reporting, analytics, and data product requirements
Translate business problems into clear user stories, business requirements, data definitions, and acceptance criteria
Act as an architectural partner by evaluating and recommending the best approach across Databricks, reporting layers, analytical workflows, and AI-enabled solutions
Facilitate workshops and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders while managing expectations, trade-offs, and delivery scope
Support data modeling activities aligned to business semantics including dimensions, measures, hierarchies, grain, and lineage requirements
Contribute to reporting design, source-to-target mapping, semantic layer development, reusable data products, and data consumption patterns
Lead or support end-to-end testing of reports, datasets, and analytical outputs, validating results against source systems and business rules
Ensure solutions meet standards for data quality, accuracy, governance, usability, and identify opportunities for AI-driven insights, automation, and decision support

About The Team

The Customer Operations and Risk organization supports the customer lifecycle and lead-to-cash processes across the enterprise. As part of the Business Systems function within the Data Management and Analytics team, you will help deliver trusted data, reporting, and insights that enable informed decision-making. The team partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to design scalable analytics solutions, promote responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities, and drive continuous improvement across reporting and operational processes.

For US-based roles only: the anticipated hiring base salary range for this position is $142,500.00 - $206,700.00, depending on factors such as experience, education, level, skills, and location. This range is based on a full-time position. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for incentive compensation. Moody’s also offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, parental leave, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, a discounted employee stock purchase plan, and tuition reimbursement.

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator | Capital Markets & Business Operations | Remote Independent Contractor
new_jobs.description:
Project Coordinator | Capital Markets & Business Operations | Remote Independent Contractor

Executive Agility is seeking expressions of interest from an experienced
Project Coordinator
to join our growing team. This remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement, is an execution & project coordination role with administrative, communication & delivery responsibilities across multiple concurrent projects. You can work from anywhere within the United States. We are not accepting applications from overseas candidates.

The role combines project coordination, administration, client service, document control, communications & digital operations. The successful contractor must be highly organized, detail-driven, AI-literate & comfortable working with senior executives, boards, auditors, lawyers, bankers, contractors & clients.

🔷 WHO WE ARE

Executive Agility is the listing readiness quarterback for U.S. & Canadian capital markets. We help companies prepare for & execute domestic IPOs, up-listings, dual listings, cross-border listings, SPACs & de-SPACs.

We solve two problems: execution readiness & execution coordination. We diagnose the gaps, build the roadmap, execute governance, PCAOB audit & disclosure-readiness workstreams, deploy interim or fractional executives, place independent board directors & coordinate the critical path across counsel, auditors, bankers, boards & management.

Our role is to keep every workstream moving concurrently, not sequentially, so companies accelerate schedule, reduce costs & reduce execution risk.

🔷 THE ROLE

The Project Coordinator will:
✔ Manage project schedules, milestones & execution timelines
✔ Build & maintain Gantt charts, scorecards, trackers & KPI templates
✔ Track actions, risks, issues, decisions & deliverables in structured registers
✔ Coordinate information requests across clients, advisors, contractors & stakeholders
✔ Prepare concise status reports to keep leadership & clients informed
✔ Schedule & coordinate meetings, agendas, minutes, decisions & follow-up actions
✔ Maintain document control, version control & structured filing environments
✔ Coordinate Virtual Data Room setup, uploads, permissions & indexing
✔ Monitor designated inboxes, route emails & track client requests
✔ Handle client enquiries, scheduling, correspondence & follow-ups
✔ Coordinate contractor & candidate administration, records, onboarding documentation, agreements, SOWs & digital execution
✔ Maintain CRM, contact, contractor, candidate & project records
✔ Assist with proposals, presentations, reports, templates & routine business correspondence
✔ Coordinate social-media posting, content scheduling, website updates, outreach & email campaigns
✔ Use AI productivity tools to improve research, drafting, reporting, meeting documentation & workflow efficiency
✔ Identify delays, missing information & unresolved actions and escalate them promptly
✔ Ensure follow-through across assigned workstreams with minimal supervision.

🔷 ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

✔ Prior experience in project coordination, PMO support, project management.
✔ Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams & deadlines
✔ Experience maintaining schedules, Gantt charts, trackers, registers & reports
✔ Strong administration capability, including inboxes, scheduling, records, communications & follow-up
✔ Strong written communication, client-service & reporting skills
✔ High discipline in document control, version control & information management
✔ Competence with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint & Excel
✔ Practical AI literacy and experience using generative-AI tools in business workflows
✔ Ability to work remotely, prioritize independently & deliver agreed outcomes
✔ Sound judgement, confidentiality, accuracy & attention to detail.

🔷 HIGH-VALUE EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS

✔ CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Practising Project Practitioner or equivalent qualification
✔ Diploma of Project Management or similar qualification accompanied by practical project-management experience
✔ Capital-markets, IPO, governance, executive-search, legal, audit, finance, consulting or advisory experience
✔ Virtual Data Room or due-diligence coordination experience
✔ Experience supporting senior executives, boards or multi-advisor projects
✔ Experience with CRM, social media, website, email-campaign or contractor-administration workflows.

Practical project-management experience & portfolio evidence will be required.

🔷 YOUR PROFILE

✔ You create structure, visibility & accountability across complex work
✔ You are comfortable combining project coordination with detailed administration & client service
✔ You communicate professionally with executives, clients, advisors & contractors
✔ You can independently manage routine activities while escalating material issues promptly
✔ You can demonstrate schedules, Gantt charts, registers, dashboards, reports or workflows you have created
✔ You are dependable, responsive & able to keep multiple priorities moving without constant supervision.

🔷 ENGAGEMENT MODEL

✔ Remote, part-time independent-contractor engagement
✔ Variable hours based on client & business requirements

🔷 HOW TO APPLY

Apply via LinkedIn with a current CV. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly by Executive Agility for a confidential conversation.

Approaches from recruitment agencies will not be responded to.
